preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 10 and s.islower() and s.isalpha() for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each of the n strings contains only lowercase letters and has length between 1 and 10.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 500000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= L <= n and 1 <= R <= n for (L, R, _) in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, L and R are valid 1-based indices within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(sub) <= 10 and sub.islower() and sub.isalpha() for (_, _, sub) in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, the substring pattern consists only of lowercase letters and has length between 1 and 10.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == sum(1 for j in range(L-1, R) if sub in strings[j]) for i, (L, R, sub) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query i with parameters L, R, and substring sub, the i-th output line is the count of strings in the 1-based range [L, R] that contain sub as a substring.
